verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents rule-defined fixes that a developer can apply directly to files with the `--autofix` flag, so findings can be acted on rather than only read. The 'suggested fixes' side of the story rests only on marketing lines about fixing and remediation, with no documented workflow. Missing for 10: documented suggested-fix delivery (e.g., fix suggestions in PR comments or the IDE), AI-generated fix documentation beyond marketing claims, details on autofix scope and limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autofix working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports

citations.quote: You can apply the Rule-defined fix directly to the file using the `--autofix` flag.
